name: CA-43
label: Safe D

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Maxine Waters running for reelection
Polymarket prices Waters near 95% to win
Republican challenger Cristian Morales has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Waters holds a seat with a D+27 partisan lean, enjoys incumbency and a large fundraising edge, and markets price her around 95% to win, with no polls or ratings suggesting a competitive race. The forecast stays at a roughly 28-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race or a major outside-spending surge for Morales would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maxine Waters seeks another term in a Los Angeles-area district that leans heavily Democratic, giving Republicans little structural opening. She advanced to the general election and has raised more than $860,000, while challenger Cristian Morales reports no fundraising and has drawn no outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals.

Prediction markets put Waters' win probability near 95%, consistent with a comfortable double-digit margin. Barring an unexpected scandal or a late surge of outside spending, the seat is expected to remain in Democratic hands by a wide margin.
